entities.summary: Charles Napier, a notable figure in the history of Pakistan, associated with Sikh Empire and British Conquest (1843–1858). Preceded by Sindh and Frontier Annexation and British annex Sindh after defeating the Talpur Mirs at the Battle of Miani. Their legacy influenced All-India Muslim League founded at Dhaka.
